1409-3671-7824.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve the Wily Goblin trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

475-549-1274-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-1274-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4050-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-4050-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

240-5147-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-4460-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4460-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater.

1636-2034-5803-7248.description:
Cast Valgavoth's Onslaught by paying its mana cost.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Valgavoth's Onslaught.
Resolve the copy of Valgavoth's Onslaught, causing you to put a card from your library onto the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the face-down creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3899-5223.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3168-4955-7070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
Urza's Incubator is naming one of the additional nontoken creature's types.
3168-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
Repeat.

985-3835-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-6471.description:
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Will of the Temur twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Will of the Temur spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1263-2018-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities from steps 1 and 5
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2743-5362-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-5362-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-5362-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Quantum Misalignment at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Quantum Misalignment spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

3152-4770-6623.description:
Activate Somberwald Sage by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Somberwald Sage.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4779-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4779-5776-5777.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1365-3263-3698-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-3698-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 2, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

711-1029-4289.notablePrerequisites: Fallowsage does not have summoning sickness.
711-1029-4289.description:
Activate Fallowsage by tapping it, adding {1}.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Fallowsage.
Repeat.

2579-4215-5073.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve The Cauldron of Eternity's trigger first, putting Tinder Wall on the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning Tinder Wall to the battlefield.
Repeat.

864-2104-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Eternal Witness.
864-2104-4305.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
